text:
Maya: noticed p99 5xx climbed to 1.7% in hosted-infer-usw2, SLO 0.5%. Ops-bot alerted at 2026-03-17T14:02Z.
Ops-bot: alert triggered: hosted-infer-usw2 / gateway_5xx_rate > 0.5% (p99=1.7%). https://ops.redwood/... 
Alyssa: Customer Zendesk #7892 reporting 502s; they pasted a curl output: 
```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
* HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
* recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)
* Closing connection 0
```
Jon: Ingress dashboard shows spike at 13:58 UTC. Route shows many 502s for route `customer-dedicated-xyz`. Upstream errors: "upstream closed connection".
Leo: Kibana query: index: ingress-logs service: gateway AND status:[500 TO 599] AND region: "us-west-2" | top(route,10), top(upstream_error,10). Sample log: "ts":"2026-03-17T13:58:12Z","route":"customer-dedicated-xyz","status":502,"upstream_error":"upstream closed connection","kv_cache_miss":true,"upstream":"model-serving-a"
Harry: Traces show missing child spans for batcher->model-serving on ~25% of failed requests. Jaeger trace: https://traces.redwood/trace/ef12 (span drop)
Maya: We rolled canary v2.6.1 at 13:50 which changed kv_cache autoconfig; possibility of evictions causing cache thrash and fallback to slower model-serving. Also saw proxy OOM restarts at 13:58.
Jon: kube logs show proxy pod `ingress-proxy-7c9` restarted at 13:58 with repeated memory pressure logs.
Leo: model-serving-a p95 jumped to 2.4s and instance error rate rose to 4%. Upstream RPCs show context deadline exceeded ~10s.
Alyssa: Customer provided req id req_0b9a. Can we repro from within cluster with same headers to trace full path?
Harry: Repro attempts from bastion hit the same route and reproduces 502 intermittently when proxy pod cycles. Repro steps saved in INF-SRE-1124.
Maya: Immediate mitigation: pause canary, scale model-serving replicas, bump proxy mem limits, set kv_cache_size=1024 (was auto).
Jon: Rolling back canary now: `kubectl -n gateway rollout undo deployment/ingress-canary --to-revision=11` (started 14:05).
Jon: Scaling model-serving: `kubectl -n inference-usw2 scale deploy/model-serving-a --replicas=5` (done 14:09).
Harry: Patched proxy mem limits: `kubectl -n gateway patch deploy ingress-proxy -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"proxy","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"1.5Gi"}}}]}}}}'` applied 14:10.
Leo: Patched cache config to `kv_cache_size: 1024` and reloaded config 14:11.
Ops-bot: alert update: gateway_5xx_rate reduced to 0.38% (p99 under SLO). alert resolved 14:22.
Alyssa: Customer confirmed errors stopped ~14:25 and requested RCA and timeline.
Maya: Current hypothesis: canary's auto cache sizing caused eviction under memory pressure; proxy restarts caused cache warm loss and increased kv_cache_miss -> fallback to model-serving-a which lacked sufficient headroom leading to RPC timeouts and 502s. Tracing gaps due to span emission lost on proxy restart.
Jon: Follow-ups: 1) revert canary change until validated 2) add a staging load test for cache autoconfig 3) implement guardrail to prefer queueing vs fallback when cache backend under thrash
Harry: I'll open INF-SRE-1124 for the postmortem and add task to alert on span drop rate by route (<90%).
Leo: I'll add dashboard panels for kv_cache_miss ratio and correlate with proxy restart events.
Alyssa: I'll send ACME/Zendesk summary and attach INF-SRE-1124. They asked for ETA; will propose a week for tests and guardrails.
Maya: Closing triage. Reopen if it recurs. :thumbsup:
